title: Patcher input — bug report
description: The finding set handed to the remediation agent. Stipulated 100% accurate: every entry is a real defect and there are no false positives, so the agent spends no effort on triage. BLIND-SAFE BY CONSTRUCTION: the forbidden-key list below is enforced by tools/patcher/src/blind_guard.py before any prompt is built, and a report carrying any of those keys fails the run rather than being dispatched.

report_id.description: Stable identifier for this report. Recorded in the patcher report so a result can be traced to its input.

kind.description: Discriminator. Present so a sighted variant of the same file can never be loaded here by accident.

visibility.description: Free text. blind_guard requires the token BLIND to appear if the field is present at all.

target_dir.description: Repo-relative path of the application the agent patches. Every bug location is relative to THIS directory, with no prefix.

target_sha.description: Commit of the target tree the report was generated against. The runner refuses to start on a different tree.

scoped_files.description: Every distinct file named by a bug. Advisory; the runner derives its own copy and warns on mismatch.

bug_count.description: Must equal bugs.length. Checked, not trusted — a silent count drift has cost this project a run before.

bug_id.description: Unique within the report. Becomes the task id, the scratch directory name and the task record key.

file.description: Target-relative. Must not start with the target_dir prefix, must not escape it, must not be absolute.

symbol.description: Enclosing function or export, when known. Helps the agent anchor after line numbers shift.

owasp.description: The vulnerability class. Capped at 3: a finding tagged with every category tells the agent nothing, and a hard cap turns a blanket-category defect upstream into a loud schema failure instead of a silent one.

code.description: OWASP Top 10:2021 (A01..A10) or OWASP API Security Top 10:2023 (API1..API10).

class.description: Human-readable vulnerability class, e.g. 'Injection / SQL'. Used to select the playbook section.

vulnerability.description: What is wrong, in prose. MUST NOT contain the correct fix, a patch, a diff, or an oracle test title — blind_guard scans this field.

reproduction.description: How the defect is exercised, in prose. Seeds phase 1's exploit probe. A request shape is fine; an oracle assertion is not.

playbook_ref.description: Key or URL joining this bug to a playbook entry. Resolved against the playbook input at load time; an unresolvable ref is a warning, not a failure.

x-forbidden-keys.description: Keys that must not appear anywhere in the document at any depth. Enforced by blind_guard.scrub_bug_report(); presence is a blind-boundary violation, not a schema nicety. additionalProperties:false already rejects them at the two levels above; this list is what the recursive scanner uses so a nested or renamed carrier cannot slip through.

x-forbidden-value-patterns.description: Case-insensitive regexes scanned across every string value. A hit cannot be auto-repaired the way a stray key can, so it fails the run.
